title: Establish the validated remote agent worktree
purpose: Provide a bounded GitHub Actions worktree in which an AI development agent can apply one scoped patch from an internal agent pull request, build and test it without write credentials, then commit the exact tested result only to the originating agent branch.
invariants: The workflow only accepts same-repository pull requests whose head branch matches agent/**.
The workflow never writes directly to main or to a non-agent branch.
Patched repository code is built and tested in a job without persisted Git credentials and with contents read permission only.
The write-token job does not execute the patched test suite and only stages the previously tested result envelope.
Every job is tied to an exact full base commit, one agent branch, machine-checkable allowed paths and fixed test profiles.
Workflow, governance, architecture, work-package, binary, symlink and submodule changes are rejected by the fast agent lane.
A successful run removes the temporary job envelope before committing the tested result.
requiredEvidence: local isolated smoke test of prepare, apply, package and commit-prepare phases
GitHub Actions end-to-end smoke run through an internal agent pull request
result commit restricted to the originating agent branch
temporary job envelope removed from the successful branch tree
documented trust boundary and recovery procedure
adversarialTests: reject a pull request whose head repository is not the current repository
reject non-job changes staged before READY
reject paths outside allowedPaths or inside permanent forbidden areas
reject binary patches, symlinks and submodules
reject a moved branch between validation and commit
reject a result patch whose digest or final scope differs from the tested result
prevent a successful result push from recursively applying a second time
nonGoals: modify repository rulesets or branch protection
support arbitrary shell commands supplied by an agent job
activate held architecture, backend, synchronization, identity or commerce work
independentReview: end-to-end internal agent pull request inspected before acceptance
rollback: Revert the infrastructure pull requests. Existing application source, promoted RC715 baseline, active RC718 candidate and repository data are unaffected; agent branches containing unprocessed job envelopes can be deleted without migration.
